scripts.build: node --check src/main.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const js=fs.readFileSync('src/main.js','utf8');const html=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8');if(/import\s+[^;]*style\.css/.test(js)){throw new Error('Do not import CSS from src/main.js when serving with python http.server; link it from index.html instead.')}if(!html.includes('<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"/src/style.css\">')){throw new Error('index.html must link /src/style.css for the static server build.')}"
